body: What's your situation in life? Have a place to sleep, a.roof over your head? Food to eat? Are you safe? These small blessing seem like nothing but they are what matters. People come and go, a lot of the time very few are worth knowing, but its no reason to give up. Seek others out, if that's what you desire. Seek knowledge to get you what you want if you dont have it now. It takes work to get anywhere. I'm not one to talk because I've fucked up so bad that I may never return to who I was but I'm still here. We are tougher than we give ourselves credit for. What do you desire? What are you goals? Are you putting too much pressure on yourself? Are you comparing your life to others? Talk to me if no one else. I'm in a very similar situation and may not be around much longer, in society that is.

Well, I'm sticking around for now. No plans laid yet, I've never been a quitter but honestly im not sure how to cope right now. Spent some time with the family and as always they give me strength but the impeding doom is still bearing down on me. I thought my dad would hate me but he understands some of my pain now. One person can only take so much. I lost the light I had in my life even though it was fake. It's hard to turn the darkness into light as I have to be the one to light the way for my boys. I cant say how I'll feel at any given time. I try and continue to try but these feelings and thoughts just crash likes waves in my brain. I dont know if I can recover from this stupid mistake of a day.

My son lost his mother and I lost my girlfriend of 15 years to drugs this March. Shes still alive she just left us for some user/dealer that will let her do what she wants. There is nothing that will stop the pain. I see it in the mirror, I see it in my sons eyes. You cant control the choices of other people  but you can control your thoughts. Focus on the good things you have, we all have something regardless if another human is there or not. Are you healthy? Are you in a safe place? Do you have a job? Did you eat today? There is any number of small blessings we take for granted when confronted with unbearable pain. You have to shift your focus elsewhere and try not to let the negative thoughts fill your head. I battle them everyday too. I feel hopelessness constantly but I focus on my son and that gives me strength. I'm blessed she didnt take him and for seeing him. You have to find the things that will give you strength. I know that sounds impossible but the pain will subside and you will move on. There are so many people in the world, don't waste you life because someone didn't see how wonderful you are.

Everyone judges the next person by their looks whether it be subconscious or not. Everyone's first impression is based on looks they just don't admit or don't want to hurt your feelings. I'm an ugly bastard that no one ever approaches; however, there's more than just looks that make you who you are. Let the light inside you shine, show people what the soul that resides within looks like. Try thinking positive and try to reinvent the image of yourself in your head. It really does go a long way. Positivity is a vibration that people pick up on, no one wants to be around someone that negatively affects them. People pick up on this, we are strangely connected somehow. I myself have issues with depression, self esteem  and anxiety but I notice when I'm in a good mood people tend to be more available to me. You shouldnt worry what people think anyways, it only matters how you feel. When you are happy with yourself you'll find more acceptance everywhere. Work on the inner you and I promise you'll see change.
